@cover: The picture a series or a library shows in the grids.
@cover_automatic: The cover the server picks: a series' first book's, a library's first series'.
delete_library_explanation: Its series and books stay, and so do the files.
delete_series_explanation: Only a series without books can be deleted.
@end_year: A series' last year of release, such as 2021.
@folder_library: Under a folder's path in the list of folders; {library} is the library's name.
folder_path_help: Its full path, as the server sees it, such as /Users/you/Books.
folder_scanned: Once added, the server reads the folder in the background, and its books appear as it goes.
folders_empty: There are no folders yet. Add the one your books are in.
name: Name
@no_library: Next to a series that no library holds yet.
own_library: Give it a library of its own
own_library_off: Its series wait in no library until you add them to one.
own_library_on: A new library receives its series.
remove_folder_explanation: Its books leave the catalog, and so do the series left without books. The files stay on the server, and so does its library.
series_empty: There are no series yet. A scan finds them in the server's folders.
@start_year: A series' first year of release, such as 1989.
title: Manage
@title: The admin's screen for folders, libraries and series, opened from the user menu.
